stages.name: championship_series
stages.note: mestaruussarja; title decided on total points, 32 games

stages.name: challenger_series
stages.note: haastajasarja; only 27 games, so the bottom half plays five fewer matches than the top half

playoff.note: Winner plays in Veikkausliiga 2027; 12th is relegated directly.
Champion is promoted directly. Separately, 9th plays the Ykkönen runner-up over two legs for the last Ykkösliiga place.

stages.name: promotion_round
stages.note: winner promoted; runner-up into the play-off

playoff.note: Both legs played; the Ykkösliiga club keeps its place if it wins.

stages.name: Etelä-Suomi lohko B
stages.note: one of three 12-team Uusimaa groups; the other seven groups hold 8-12 clubs (110 clubs in total)

playoff.note: Group winners do not go up automatically: they contest the promotion places to Kakkonen, and six clubs are promoted in a normal season (subject to licence and to Kakkonen vacancies).

boundaries.note: Ykkösliiga: champion up, 2nd into a two-legged play-off. Veikkausliiga: 12th down, 11th into the same play-off.
Ykkönen: promotion-round winner up, runner-up into a two-legged play-off against the Ykkösliiga 9th. Ykkösliiga: 10th down, 9th into that play-off.

conflicts.real: Kolmonen is 10 regional groups (110 clubs); KOG2 is the Uusimaa 'Etelä-Suomi lohko B' of 12
conflicts.note: Size and level are right for that group, but the group is one of ten and its winner must win a promotion play-off to reach Kakkonen.

conflicts.real: Kakkonen (level 4): 30 clubs in three groups of 10, double round robin then a championship/relegation split
conflicts.note: Our rows jump from Ykkönen (t3) to Kolmonen (t5). Kakkonen is the missing link: FIYK relegates into it and KOG2 promotes into it, so no boundary between our t3 and t5 rows can be encoded without it.

notes: Calendar-year season: the season overlapping the 2026-27 career year is the 2026 season; '2026-27' is only the dataset label. Levels: Veikkausliiga (1), Ykkösliiga (2), Ykkönen (3), Kakkonen (4, not in our rows), Kolmonen (5), Nelonen (6, district-run). The Veikkausliiga split is asymmetric: the top six play a double round robin (32 games), the bottom six a single one (27), points carried in full. Ykkösliiga is a 10-club triple round robin (27 games) with no split. Kakkonen's three group winners 'may' be promoted, so the number of Kolmonen promotions (up to six) depends on Kakkonen vacancies and licences.
